item.title: Portman Hockey’s 4th annual “Great Skate” postponed
item.description: DULUTH, Minn. — Messy weather has forced Portman Hockey to postpone their annual “Great Skate” fundraiser. The event typically signals the “official start” of Portman’s outdoor hockey season. The “Great Skate” fundraiser has consistently been a family-friendly, community-favorite event with food, games, and activities for all ages. item.description: HERMANTOWN, Minn.- A Hermantown football standout will make the jump to the college ranks next fall. item.title: Hartel’s Disposal wraps up $75,000 gift for Salvation Army
item.description: DULUTH, Minn. — The Duluth Salvation Army and Hartel’s Disposal have wrapped up their “Hartel’s Holiday Impact Challenge”.
